rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer) names the item. This sheet has no centavo combs: every amount is one 12-slot comb, so amounts print the writer's official text (1,234.56) right-aligned from derived: keys of to_print_field_map (commas dropped only when the text would not fit; blank when it still does not). Other values the sheet prints differently from the submitted controls also come from derived: keys, never from the submitted XML: the Item 2 MM and YY digit boxes, the Item 5 ATC code and description line, the two-line name and address combs, the 9-digit page 2 TIN, and the rate boxes (whole percent; Schedule 1 B adds the tenths box after the printed point; a rate the boxes cannot show stays blank, and the Schedule 3 rate prints only while Schedule 3 is open). Both TIN combs preprint the branch code 00000 (no fillable branch cell), so a non-head-office branch code cannot print. Booleans fill X in the box beside the printed option. The signatory/title/TIN cells and Part III Details of Payment are not joined: the model holds no values for them. The page 2 name comb (24 slots) prints the first 24 characters. The submitted XML always carries every control.
